question: does the training environment change the King OOF, and which environment is the NEW_S scheme?

scheme_source.says: exports NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES="X86_V4 AVX512_ICL AVX512_SPR"; King uses PV=/workspace/venv/bin/python (AMENDMENT 2, lead ruling (a), P314 -> PV); legs uses P314 with OMP=OPENBLAS=1; F10 uses PV with the variable UNSET and OMP=OPENBLAS=2

why_it_matters: my first pass launched King and legs with plain python3 and no NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES, read off the device names instead of the chain script (E-0826-D). Gates B1/B2 compare this book against NEW_S, so the training environment has to be the one NEW_S actually ran, not merely a working one.
finding: three environments, three different King OOFs, although the version strings are IDENTICAL in both interpreters (python 3.11.10 / numpy 2.4.6 / lightgbm 4.7.0). Recording versions is not enough to reproduce a run; the interpreter path and the numpy CPU-feature mask are part of the scheme.
adopted: run4 = PV + NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES set, per news_chain_resume.sh
consequence: legs and F10 rerun on run4 KING_OOF; the first-pass legs.npz (9ee5886f) and the F10 run that reached 16/23 folds are discarded
